changes.title: Healing-only potion conversion setting
changes.text: The APD conversion slider now affects only generated Healing potions becoming Shielding; other potions and scrolls retain the original Exotic Crystals behavior.

changes.title: Identify corrected conversion rules
changes.text: Keep corrected nonzero Healing-only settings distinct from older global-conversion rules without changing stored histories or neutral rules.

changes.title: Verify conversion scope and saved settings
changes.text: Check both loot-generation paths, all trinket levels, unaffected potion and scroll types, exact RNG behavior and save/load identity.

changes.title: Check Healing setting on Android
changes.text: Open the real settings window, verify the Healing-only explanation and layout, retain a screenshot and preserve the selected value.

changes.title: Record correction and exact build evidence
changes.text: Document the reproduced conversion bug and request full verification against the immediately preceding APK.

commentary: I corrected the conversion slider to affect only Healing potions becoming Shielding and clarified its wording. The trinket's other conversions keep normal SPD behavior; saved values, scoring and historical records remain intact.
